doc.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11

title: Opening in New York in 1917 and Chicago's lack of jazz bands
summary: Sbarbaro describes the 1917 New York room and arriving in Chicago with no jazz band to be found; Tom Brown's band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
